name: Neon
description:
This paint was designed specifically for those helpers who are responsible for organizing daily Events. This paint is an integral attribute of the administrative assistants who organize entertainment in the game. The bright neon-yellow color was chosen for a reason: the helpers in this paint will stand out on the battlefield, and players will always know who they can contact during a competition or event.
This paint goes to all Event helpers - those who dedicate their time to designing and organizing Events to continually bring original battles to the community, as well as dealing with trolls who try to spoil the fun of honest players.
interestingFacts: The paint is the same color as Mono Yellow.
The paint was removed from the game in early June 2022, after the Contests Organizers and Event Helpers teams were disbanded.
